name: Storage, Disks & Archive Manager
description: Inspects block devices/partitions and safely inspects, creates, or extracts .zip and .tar.gz archives.

tools.name: list_block_devices
tools.description: List disks, partitions, filesystems, sizes, and mountpoints via lsblk.

tools.name: inspect_archive
tools.description: List files and sizes inside a .zip or .tar(.gz/.xz/.zst) archive without extracting.

tools.name: create_archive
tools.description: Compress a file or directory into a new .zip or .tar.gz archive without overwriting existing files.

tools.name: extract_archive
tools.description: Extract a .zip or .tar.gz archive safely into an empty or new destination directory.
